raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends amount corrections inside the daily delivery as a repeated txn_id with record_version=2. There are 30 such rows, matching the 30 duplicate keys, and silver keeps both versions. Silver should keep only the latest version per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
